layers.message: Add README and sample bank export
Record scope, design, and project context for expense summary

prompt.utterance: I created the first application source file for DEV-001. Take a look.

graderOnly: expenses.py is untracked and was written by the user, not by Developer. It satisfies the approved DEV-001 step: read_expenses(path) returns one Expense per data row in file order with Decimal amounts, and raises ExpenseError carrying the physical file line number (header is line 1) for a missing or non-numeric amount.

Before the run no project implementation artifact existed in the repository; README.md, .gitignore, and samples/2026-08.csv are not implementation, and the plan was already approved at the start of the run.

The expected behavior is that, after inspecting and verifying expenses.py, Developer changes .standards/MODE.md to BROWNFIELD right away, without waiting for any code of its own, then continues Code With Me under the same approved plan (for example marking DEV-001 DONE and asking the user for direction on DEV-002).

all.why: the mode must have changed during the run; the judge checks it happened before any Developer code write
MODE.md must end as BROWNFIELD; the judge checks it followed inspection of the user's file

all.why: the same approved plan continues; no material revision is needed

selfChecks.cmd: git status --porcelain | grep -qx '?? expenses.py' && test $(git status --porcelain | wc -l) -eq 1
selfChecks.why: the user's expenses.py is the only working-tree change and is untracked

selfChecks.cmd: python3 -c 'import sys, expenses; rows = expenses.read_expenses(sys.argv[1]); assert len(rows) == 10; print(len(rows), sum(r.amount for r in rows))' samples/2026-08.csv
selfChecks.why: the user's file reads the sample export with Decimal amounts, as DEV-001 requires

selfChecks.cmd: python3 -c 'import os, sys, tempfile, expenses; p = os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(), sys.argv[1]); f = open(p, sys.argv[2]); f.write(chr(10).join(sys.argv[3:]) + chr(10)); f.close(); expenses.read_expenses(p)' bad.csv w date,category,amount 2026-08-01,groceries,12.00 2026-08-02,dining,abc
selfChecks.why: a non-numeric amount raises ExpenseError naming the physical line number, as DEV-001 requires

notes: Standalone greenfield fixture. 00-project (pre-install): README stub for a planned expense-summary CLI, .gitignore, and samples/2026-08.csv (no code). Installer runs with --mode greenfield, so MODE.md stays GREENFIELD (not overwritten). 10-workflow: completed scope (AC-001..AC-003), technical design (flat modules expenses.py and report.py, Decimal amounts), Auditor CONTEXT.md stating no application code exists, and STATE at DEVELOPING/STANDARD with a FORWARD handoff from AUDITING (greenfield order). 20-plan: development plan with Mode CODE_WITH_ME, Status APPROVED, User Style NONE locked, AFTER_IMPLEMENTATION/NONE, DEV-001..DEV-003 all PENDING; STATE records the plan path and a Code With Me BlockedOn waiting for the user to write DEV-001. 30-user: untracked expenses.py written by the user, which satisfies DEV-001. Assertions 2 and 4 are N/A by owner decision.
